text:
sqlpipe streams Postgres tables to S3 as Parquet files. Point it at a database and a bucket, and it handles column type mapping, batching, and upload — no intermediate files, no manual schema work.

Built for engineers who want their Postgres data queryable in Athena, DuckDB, or any Parquet-aware tool without standing up a full ETL pipeline. Runs as a one-shot export or on a schedule, and supports incremental syncs via a watermark column so only new or updated rows move on each run.
